species.name: Trout
why: Water 64°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 26–40 ft deep, mostly on drop-offs.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 35 ft, cold below.

species.name: Spotted bass
why: Water 64°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–32 ft deep, mostly on drop-offs.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 35 ft, cold below.

species.name: Catfish
why: Water 64°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 18–34 ft deep, mostly on sheltered coves.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 35 ft, cold below.
